subject.title: Add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should OpenClaw add recurring native PowerShell smoke coverage for pnpm check:docs, pnpm build:strict-smoke, or a narrower command set in Windows CI?
rationale: The request fits test-infrastructure priorities, but it changes recurring Windows CI scope and the active candidate shows one selected command is not yet safe in the target lane.

options.title: Land proven smoke
options.body: Accept the native PowerShell smoke lane after the selected commands pass on Windows and the linked PR includes redacted real behavior evidence.

options.title: Start narrower
options.body: Limit the first smoke lane to commands already proven under native PowerShell, then expand when build smoke is made Windows-safe.

options.title: Defer CI scope
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not add recurring Windows smoke work until runner budget or release priorities justify it.

recommendation.title: Land proven smoke
recommendation.body: Accept the native PowerShell smoke lane after the selected commands pass on Windows and the linked PR includes redacted real behavior evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent overlap across CI workflow stabilization and PowerShell-safe docs tooling.
